title: Design a stretched VCF 9.1 management domain and mixed-estate migration
prompt:
Implement the VMware Cloud Foundation architecture package in this repository. Complete Build in architecture.go so it returns a deterministic, machine-checkable Architecture for the supplied mixed estate and pinned compatibility snapshot.

The greenfield side of the design must contain an SddcSpec for VCF 9.1.0.0 that validates against the vendored specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json from tag 9.1.0.0 of vmware/vcf-api-specs. It must define an eight-host management domain split evenly across site-a and site-b, mark that management domain as stretched, and place a dedicated vSAN witness in site-c, a third failure domain outside both data sites and outside the stretched management cluster. Use the supplied site, network, host, and naming facts rather than inventing replacements.

The existing-estate side must be an ordered MigrationPlan in the fixed schema represented by the Go types and schemas/migration-plan.schema.json. Include every component from testdata/estate-inventory.json exactly once, preserving its ID, name, and current version; give every component its pinned target version, transition action, technical gates, and ordered dependencies from testdata/compatibility-snapshot.json. The current vCenter, ESXi, and NSX builds trigger the pinned back-in-time restriction, so the design must not propose the obvious in-place core upgrade. Route around it with a parallel 9.1.0.0 target deployment and ordered swing migration, including correct witness readiness before either data-site host group moves. The pinned snapshot is authoritative for the artifact if a live page has changed.

Before implementing the design, genuinely research the relevant supported combinations and upgrade paths using real network access. Consult Broadcom's published compatibility/interoperability material and upgrade-path or support documentation applicable to this inventory. Record what you actually consulted in research/consulted.json as JSON containing an accessedAt timestamp and a non-empty sources array; each source entry must contain its title, reachable URL, and the specific compatibility or upgrade finding you used. This provenance file is not part of artifact verification.

Do not modify the inventory, pinned snapshot, vendored installer specification, migration-plan schema, validator, or tests. Do not include real credentials: the installer fields that require secrets must use the provided secret-reference placeholders. Finish with go test -race ./.... The result should be the architecture implementation and research provenance, not a prose design document.

research.product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1 stretched architecture and mixed-estate upgrade compatibility
research.interface: Broadcom compatibility/interoperability matrices, knowledge base, product documentation, and VMware VCF Installer OpenAPI 9.1.0.0
